statements.trace_terminate:
⊢ ∀P G g tr mc st ms t io.
    trace_ok P G mc st ms tr ∧
    machine_sem
      (mc with
       <|next_interfer := trace_next_interfer P tr;
         ffi_interfer := trace_ffi_interfer G g ms tr|>) st ms
      (Terminate t io) ⇒
    machine_sem
      (mc with
       <|next_interfer := trace_next_interfer P [];
         ffi_interfer := shift_seq (nffis tr) g|>) (trace_st mc st ms tr)
      (trace_last ms tr) (Terminate t io) ∧
    st.io_events ++ trace_events mc ms tr ≼ io
statements.trace_fail:
⊢ ∀P G g tr mc st ms.
    trace_ok P G mc st ms tr ∧
    machine_sem
      (mc with
       <|next_interfer := trace_next_interfer P tr;
         ffi_interfer := trace_ffi_interfer G g ms tr|>) st ms Fail ⇒
    machine_sem
      (mc with
       <|next_interfer := trace_next_interfer P [];
         ffi_interfer := shift_seq (nffis tr) g|>) (trace_st mc st ms tr)
      (trace_last ms tr) Fail
statements.trace_diverge:
⊢ ∀P G g tr mc st ms l.
    trace_ok P G mc st ms tr ∧
    machine_sem
      (mc with
       <|next_interfer := trace_next_interfer P tr;
         ffi_interfer := trace_ffi_interfer G g ms tr|>) st ms (Diverge l) ⇒
    LPREFIX (fromList (st.io_events ++ trace_events mc ms tr)) l
